notes: INSIDE half of the Net Mouth (scrap, 2x2): a riveted junk hopper with a patched chute and a dial gauge. on: scrap bits slowly tumble down the hopper (6 frames); pulling: the same, faster, with the gauge swinging and the lamp blinking. damaged: chute dented, a bit jammed, lamp dead; disabled: a chunk jammed in the chute.
